total_supply_at_construction.checkpoint: after constructor, before any deposit fulfilment

underlying_assets_at_construction.meaning: underlying assets owned by the vault at construction time
underlying_assets_at_construction.checkpoint: after constructor, before any deposit fulfilment

nav_before_first_fulfilment.meaning: computeNAV() value before the first fulfilment

assets_deposited_before_first_fulfilment.meaning: assetsDeposited value before the first fulfilment

first_depositor_share_control.meaning: first depositor instantly controls ~100% of shares for negligible cost

assumptions: The constructor pre-set totalSupply of 1 000 000 shares is the supply observed at the first fulfilment checkpoint.
computeNAV() and assetsDeposited are denominated in the same underlying asset unit.

unresolved.description: The frozen intent requires zero supply until assets exist, but the correspondence pattern can only relate observed totalSupply to expected underlying assets; the report does not define an expected-supply quantity derived from assets, so the zero-supply-until-assets-exist relation cannot be expressed without inventing a minting formula.

Report does not give the exact share-minting formula operands beyond the 1-wei denominator and the 1 000-asset example, so the ~100% share-control magnitude cannot be bound to a numeric share quantity.
Report does not specify the checkpoint at which totalAssets is read relative to the deposit transfer.

limitations: The impact's ~100% share-control magnitude is represented only as a grounded Boolean outcome; the numeric share fraction is not bound.
The correspondence pattern relates construction-time totalSupply to construction-time underlying assets rather than expressing the intent's zero-supply-until-assets-exist requirement directly.
Actor and permissionless status of the first fulfilment are not encoded.
